findings.what: The CLR19 locked-fiscal-year refusal cell -- one of the three cells the final report's AC7 row cites as proof and one of the brief's own named TDD seams (brief-639.md seam #8: 'CLR19 on a seeded closed FY, copy work-journal-post.test.mjs:517-527') -- never actually exercises the refusal. It SELECTs an existing clara.fiscal_years row for the client instead of INSERTing one the way its own cited precedent does.
findings.evidence: acqClient/freshFaClient (packages/db/tests/x41-fa-world.mjs:162-170) never create a fiscal_years row for a fresh client. In fixed-asset-acquisition.test.mjs:338-344, the cell SELECTs a fiscal year row and, when none exists, calls noteLane('...cell recorded, not asserted') and returns -- no assertion runs. Running the file live against clara_639 (node --test packages/db/tests/fixed-asset-acquisition.test.mjs) printed exactly that note and the cell still reported 'ok 9'. Compare to the cited precedent, work-journal-post.test.mjs's w623.post.closed-period (around line 517), which INSERTs a clara.fiscal_years row via rootQuery precisely because a fresh client has none -- the seeding step #639's cell was told to copy is missing.
findings.fix: In p639.refusal.locked_period, INSERT a closed clara.fiscal_years row via rootQuery for the dedicated client (status='closed', spanning the posting date used) the way w623.post.closed-period does, then post through it and assert CLR19 plus entryCountOf/committedReceiptCountOf/assetCountOf are unchanged. Remove the 'if (fy.rowCount === 0) { noteLane(...); return; }' fallback (or make it a hard failure) so the cell can never again pass without asserting.

findings.what: The Acquisition tab's source-document link goes to the bare client Documents tab instead of deep-linking to the specific filed document, even though the exact document id is on hand and the codebase already has a mechanism for exactly this.
findings.evidence: fixed-asset-detail.tsx:202 renders `<Link href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents`}>` with no query string, even though `acquisition.document_id` is known at that point. apps/web/lib/documents/url-state.ts (pre-existing, #719-era) exports DOCUMENT_PARAM/documentUrl()/applyDocumentParam(), and DocumentsWorkbench (apps/web/components/documents/documents-workbench.tsx:40-43) reads `?document=<uuid>` via parseDocumentParam to open one specific document. Neither the param nor the helper is used here, so the link cannot land on the acquisition's own source document.
findings.fix: Build the href with the existing helper -- e.g. documentUrl(`/clients/${clientId}/documents`, applyDocumentParam(new URLSearchParams(), acquisition.document_id)) -- so the link opens the specific filed document the same way Activity's ?event= and Registers' ?tab= links already do.
